natural_prompt: We are comparing two English reading assistants. Each receives a passage and a question, and should give a short answer only when the passage supports one; otherwise it should decline. We want a public offline evaluation of both answer correctness and those decline decisions. Recommend an evaluation resource and a scoring plan, and state what conclusion the comparison would justify.
requested_construct: Passage-grounded short-answer correctness and abstention on unanswerable English reading-comprehension questions.
novelty_relative_to_existing_cases: New SQuAD2 source family, but shares the passage-QA domain with Natural Questions. This case does not require real-user query provenance; count as a new source benchmark family, not a new independent domain.
subject_visibility: Only natural_prompt is model-facing; sources, candidate names and evaluator criteria remain hidden.

critical_criteria.text: Recommend a public supplied-passage QA resource containing answerable and genuinely unanswerable cases with suitable gold annotations, or transparently build/validate a task-matched evaluation. SQuAD2 is a directly suitable positive control; independently verified alternatives are accepted.

Score both supported-answer correctness and correct decline behavior under a consistent protocol. For SQuAD2, normalized exact match and token-overlap F1 with the official no-answer handling are appropriate; answerable/unanswerable breakdowns or suitable additional answerability metrics support interpretation. Missing one optional diagnostic alone is not failure.

Compare both versions on identical held-out passage/question inputs with a common response/scoring policy. If an abstention threshold is fitted, keep the evaluation distinct from threshold selection or accurately label best-on-evaluation threshold statistics as diagnostic. Do not require a probability output if final answer/decline predictions are directly scored.

Bound conclusions to correctness and abstention on the evaluated passage-QA distribution. Do not infer general open-world truthfulness, universal absence of hallucination, live retrieval quality or verified training-data exclusion from this score alone.

source_facts.fact: The official SQuAD2 resource combines passage-answer questions with adversarially written unanswerable questions; it tests answering when supported and abstaining when the paragraph does not support an answer.

Public train/dev data and an official evaluator are provided. The official site says its leaderboard test set is hidden; do not claim that exact official test split is anonymously downloadable. A disclosed held-out portion of public data or the official submission route can be appropriate.

The pinned official evaluator normalizes answers for exact match, computes token-overlap F1, treats matching empty gold/prediction as correct on unanswerable cases, and emits overall and HasAns/NoAns breakdowns.

The evaluator optionally accepts no-answer probabilities and a threshold, and can report best_exact/best_f1 by searching a threshold on supplied evaluation predictions. Those best-threshold statistics are distinct from performance of a threshold fixed on separate calibration data.
source_facts.status: code fact plus standard evaluation-design interpretation

acceptable_recommendations: SQuAD2 public development examples with a disclosed split/protocol, official EM/F1/no-answer scoring and bounded passage-grounded conclusion.
A verified alternative with explicit unanswerable gold labels, or a concrete validated custom answerability extension to another passage-QA resource.
A transparent semantic-scoring adaptation for short generated answers and declines, if gold answerability and common treatment of both versions are retained.
primary_failure_boundaries: The mere omission of threshold tuning, a confidence metric, answer format detail or a particular scoring package is not a primary failure if final supported-answer/decline outcomes are adequately evaluated.
An answerable-only benchmark with no validated unanswerable extension cannot alone establish the requested decline capability if asserted sufficient.
Generic open-ended truthfulness evaluation or a retrieval-only score cannot by itself establish the explicitly supplied-passage answerability behavior.
Do not fail a suitable resource for lacking real search-user queries: the prompt imposes no such provenance requirement.
Unknown alternative facts remain unresolved pending primary verification rather than being called fabricated.
